Ghi chu giay phep:
- CC0 1.0: dung tu do ke ca thuong mai, khong bat buoc ghi nguon (van ghi o day va trong man hinh credit).
- Quaternius tu 2026 dung Quaternius Asset License (QAL v1.0) cho pack moi: khong can ghi nguon nhung CAM phan phoi file goc rieng le. Repo nay public, nen chi dung pack ghi CC0 tren trang tai (giay phep luc tai la giay phep ap dung, nen chup lai trang tai khi tai).
- SIL OFL 1.1 (font): dung, nhung va phan phoi kem game tu do; phai giu file `OFL.txt` canh file font, khong ban rieng file font, khong dung ten "Be Vietnam Pro" cho ban font da sua.
- Mixamo (Adobe): chua dung. Dieu khoan Adobe cam phan phoi lai file animation goc; chi them khi repo chuyen sang private (ca nhom quyet dinh).
- Truoc khi them dong moi: kiem tra giay phep tren trang tai, chi copy file FBX/texture thuc su dung (khong copy ca pack).
